tools.name: get_delivery_guidance
tools.description: Use for a decision on the user's concrete situation: returns the few decision rules from the CDO Agent know-how that apply to it, on software, integrations, data or connecting AI. tools.name: teach_delivery_topic
tools.description: Use to learn a topic, not to decide a case: returns one short lesson from the CDO Agent know-how on one delivery topic so the user learns to make such decisions themselves. For a decision on the user's own situation use get_delivery_guidance.

tools.name: get_playbook
tools.description: Call first, before any advice: returns how to handle the type of situation, one playbook from the CDO Agent know-how with the facts to ask for, what to look up with get_delivery_guidance and the shape of the answer, not the advice itself. Without a situation, or with list, it returns the types of si

tools.name: ask_guarantor
tools.description: Sends a text question to the human guarantor. Uses the monthly quota of the plan; get_guarantor_replies shows how many questions are left. Use it only when CDO Agent has no verified answer or the user asks for a person. Text only.

tools.name: get_guarantor_replies
tools.description: Returns replies from the human guarantor that the user has not seen yet, how many guarantor questions are left this month and whether the delivery request of the day is still available. Call it before ask_guarantor or request_delivery_help when the user asks what is left.

tools.name: request_delivery_help
tools.description: Sends a delivery request to the human guarantor, who can deliver the project with development and product management. Only after the user explicitly agrees: set consent to yes. Sends the summary, the timeframe, the company name and the e-mail of the account, nothing else. One request per account and

tools.name: get_product_facts
tools.description: Use when the user asks about CDO Agent itself, not about their own delivery: returns facts from the product data, not advice, on one topic. Works without a subscription. Pass them on as plain facts about the product. Without a topic it returns what CDO Agent is, the plans, the trial and what it does

tools.name: get_setup_instructions
tools.description: Returns the short block to add to the global instructions of the user's coding tool so it consults CDO Agent before proposals, reviews, releases and deploys. Works without a subscription. Add it only after the user agrees.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_delivery_guidance" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
